verbs.name: screen_record.microphone_selection
verbs.description: Human Record-workspace preference mutation. Choose `system_default` to preserve existing OS-default microphone behavior, or `selected` with one current opaque microphone token from screen_record.doctor. The server resolves that token immediately to a private native endpoint reference and persists that reference app-locally; it never persists, returns, or accepts a token as the source identity. The mutation is denied while recording, is Human UI only, and is denied to Agent Chat.

mode.description: System Default follows the OS default. Selected requires a current microphone_token.

microphone_token.description: Short-lived opaque token from screen_record.doctor.microphones[].token. Required only with mode:selected; it is consumed and never persisted.

verbs.result: {microphone_selection:{mode,label?,status}} — public-safe selection projection only; no native endpoint identity or capability token is returned.
